claim_scope: Development-only, neutral closed-shell FreeSolv molecules in water; one frozen FreeSolv GAFF geometry/topology per molecule; frozen AM1-BCC charges; CHA-GB/GBNSR6 polar energy; either the GBNSR6 surface-tension term or the PBSA cavity-plus-dispersion model. This is not a sampled finite-temperature free energy, a broad-solvent validation, or confirmation evidence.
interpretation: Development-only fixed-geometry comparison. CHA-GB changes the polar continuum endpoint; PBSA cavity/dispersion changes only the nonpolar endpoint. Neither endpoint was fit to FreeSolv labels in this workflow.

label_use_boundary.summary_phase: Experimental FreeSolv values read only after all energy records existed.
